message: Root actual deterministic probe found a read-only scope-binding gap in reconcile; preserve attempt-2/root-reconcile-scope-probe.json (source SHA e981117...). With a valid original UNKNOWN submission, changing ONLY boundary.policy.deployment_scope to different-approved-group still sends a GET to the original request's synthetic-group and returns PASS/OBSERVED. No real cloud calls. This is implementation feedback, not independent verdict. Add a committed negative test and enforce trusted provider/account/region/deployment_scope/logical target/deployment-policy binding before native reconciliation reads (including both original journal and history-fence paths). Reuse a pure trusted binding check; do not require unexpired apply preview or new mutation approval just for read-only recovery. Preserve original native identity/UNKNOWN semantics on inability to recover. Inspect other changed authority fields similarly; unsigned journal/request equality is insufficient without expected trusted policy. Existing valid readonly recovery must stay green.
